entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please wait for the next available agent.
Ugh, finally! I need to return this piece of junk helmet right now! This is completely unacceptable!
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. I can hear you're upset, and I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. I can definitely look into this for you.
You'd better! I've had this thing sitting here for over a month and I want my money back. The box is unopened, I haven't even touched it. The color is atrocious, nothing like the pictures!

I understand your frustration with the color not meeting your expectations. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a preference matter, or is there a technical fault with the helmet?

Are you deaf? I said it's the color! It's hideous! I'm not wearing it. This is a safety issue! I'll be so distracted by how awful it looks I'll probably crash. Get me your manager, I'm done talking to you.

I can certainly process a return for you without needing a manager, sir. I just need to verify your order details. Could you please provide the order number or the email address associated with your account?
Fine! It's angrycustomer@email.com. You have two minutes to fix this or I'm lighting up every review site on the internet about VeloFit.

Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, delivered 47 days ago. I've just checked our policy, and you are well within our 90-day return window.
Wait, really? So you're just going to take it back? Like I said, the box is unopened.

Yes, absolutely. It's no problem at all. I have just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to your email on file. Simply attach that to the package and you can drop it off at any local post office. A full refund will be issued once it's received at our warehouse.
Oh. Well... okay then. That's what you should have done from the start. Fine.
I'm glad I could get this sorted out for you. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a better rest of your day.
